title: Brain Death/Death by Neurologic Criteria Guidance on Communication, Objections, Pregnancy, and Public Trust: An AAN Position Statement
shortTitle: Brain Death/Death by Neurologic Criteria Guidance on Communication, Objections

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: This position statement provides updated member guidance from the American Academy of Neurology (AAN) regarding (1) communication with surrogate decision makers about brain death/death by neurologic criteria (BD/DNC), (2) management of surrogate decision-maker objections to BD/DNC, (3) the ethical considerations associated with BD/DNC determination in a pregnant person, and (4) enhancing public trust in BD/DNC.
